description: This file defines an abstract class 'TestClusterPerTest' used for managing Orleans test clusters within a testing framework. It includes setup and teardown methods, configuration hooks, and utilities for dependency injection and logging.

classes.name: TestClusterPerTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing an Orleans test cluster per test, providing setup, teardown, and configuration hooks.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster asynchronously, configuring and deploying it if necessary.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster asynchronously, stopping all silos and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method meant to be overridden to check preconditions before test execution.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method allowing customization of the test cluster configuration.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Checks and throws if preconditions for the test are not met.
